name: f1-four-verdicts
alt: One sealed archive of three files, checked four ways. Intact archive: verified, exit 0. One byte changed: failed, exit 2. Required artifact missing: not-established, exit 3. Below: the same archive is read by verifier demo/tests@v1 and by the changed verifier demo/tests@v2-stricter. Both print verified, exit 0, and both receipts are clipped together.
